README: Hand-crafted sound sheet for In This Town, Nobody Wears Gold. Times use cue/word/at only.

sections.why: Bright town hook and absurd anti-gold laws.
Emotional dusk memory of Grandpa during winter raids.
Mayor Vance's iron monopoly scam and vault.
Dark pines and Toby's Friday night Piglin test.
Short dramatic silence as Toby puts the puzzle together.
Gold neutrality, vault lever, and barter miracle.
Morning town celebration in gold boots, Grandpa returns, subscribe button.
